description: This file defines kernel module packages for FireWire and related components in the Linux kernel build system. It specifies package dependencies, configuration options, filenames, and descriptions for various FireWire support modules.

methods.name: KernelPackage/firewire
methods.description: Defines the main FireWire package with its dependencies and file references.

methods.name: KernelPackage/firewire-net
methods.description: Defines the network support over FireWire package.

methods.name: KernelPackage/firewire-ohci
methods.description: Defines the OHCI-1394 controller support package.

methods.name: KernelPackage/firewire-sbp2
methods.description: Defines the SBP-2 device support package.
